original_test_intent: Run the source 12-hour 4K randrw fio workload on every approved SSD and verify per-drive performance/health plus system stability.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Preserve source fio parameters, bind every safe target/range and collect per-drive JSON/health evidence.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Every target meets the approved 80% reference and no disallowed errors occur.

historical_reviews.v3: REWRITE_REQUIRED because V2 reduced all-drive scope to one target.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: One authorized engineer approves the exact target/range matrix; execution then follows the immutable job.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: All drives, 12 hours and original fio profile.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Stable targets, full fio semantics, schedule/reference and safety limits.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Reduced targets/runtime are project overrides and leave a documented Master gap.

original_method: Original fio profile retained; no device name is instantiated without approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Reviewed per-target fio job sections with protected JSON evidence destination.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: fio HOWTO plus project storage SOP.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: All approved drives remain separately attributable.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Write workload can destroy data and consume endurance.

safety_boundaries: Stop on target or storage fault
no_automatic_retry: No rerun or recovery after storage anomaly without approval.
review_improvement: V3.1 removes any implicit dual verification requirement and adds explicit project override/coverage accounting without lowering storage safety.
